jobs.title: Medical Scientific Liaison Romandie & Ticino
jobs.description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

Medical Scientific Liaison | Romandie & Ticino

Location: Romandie & Ticino Switzerland (Field Based)

As a Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) for the French/Italian speaking part of Switzerland, you will be part of the Medical Affairs team and will be responsible for scientific exchange with Key Opinion Leaders and Healthcare Professionals. You will serve as a competent point of contact for medical and scientific inquiries and contribute to translating current scientific evidence into clinical practice.

In this role, you will work closely with internal and external stakeholders and support the medical strategy by building sustainable scientific partnerships and communicating evidence-based information.

Your Responsibilities

• Responsible for medical and scientific exchange regarding products in the areas of Therapeutic Dermatology and Injectable Aesthetics

• Build and maintain long-term scientific relationships with Healthcare Professionals and Key Opinion Leaders in the French/Italian speaking part of Switzerland

• Present and communicate scientific and medical content during one-on-one meetings, meetings, and scientific events

• Develop and execute medical and scientific activities in line with the Medical Affairs strategy

• Provide scientifically sound medical information to internal and external stakeholders

• Collaborate with Medical Affairs, Sales, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams

• Monitor relevant scientific developments and the local healthcare market and derive medical insights

Your Profile

• Degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Health Sciences, or a comparable field (MSc or PhD)

• Professional experience in Medical Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry

• Experience with biologics or systemic therapies, ideally in Dermatology, Immunology, Allergology, or related therapeutic areas

• Experience in developing and presenting scientific content to medical audiences

• Strong communication, presentation, and relationship management skills, as well as experience in building professional networks

• Fluent French and English language skills, both written and spoken

• Willingness to travel extensively within Switzerland (approximately 80%)

What We Offer

You will work for a company that is committed to diversity and inclusion and believes that better outcomes are achieved when we reflect the perspectives of our diverse customer base.

Galderma SA offers an open culture based on mutual respect.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Galderma è leader nella categoria dermatologia pura, presente in circa 90 paesi. Offriamo un portafoglio innovativo e scientifico di marchi e servizi di punta premium che coprono l'intero spettro del mercato della dermatologia in rapida crescita attraverso l'estetica iniettabile, Der germl Skincare e Dermatologia terapeutica. Dalla nostra fondazione nel 1981, abbiamo dedicato la nostra attenzione e la passione al più grande organo del corpo umano - la pelle - rispondendo alle esigenze individuali dei consumatori e dei pazienti con risultati superiori in collaborazione con gli operatori sanitari.

Poiché capiamo che la pelle, siamo in forme le nostre vite, stiamo avanzando dermatologia per ogni storia della pelle.

Cerchiamo persone che si concentrino sul raggiungimento dei risultati, sull'apprendimento e sull'energia positiva, che devono coniugare l'iniziativa con il senso di lavoro di squadra e collaborazione, soprattutto devono essere appassionate di fare qualcosa di significativo per i consumatori, i pazienti e i professionisti sanitari che serviamo ogni giorno. Miriamo a rafforzare ogni dipendente e a promuovere la sua crescita personale, garantendo che le esigenze aziendali siano soddisfatte ora e nel futuro. In tutta la nostra azienda, abbracciamo la diversità e rispettiamo la dignità, la privacy e i diritti personali di ogni dipendente.

In Galderma, diamo attivamente ai nostri team ragioni per credere nella nostra audace ambizione di diventare la società leader nel mondo della dermatologia. Con noi, avete l'opportunità ultima di acquisire nuove e impegnative esperienze di lavoro e creare un impareggiabile, impatto diretto.

• L'Europa e la sua Europa

Luogo: Romandie & Ticino Svizzera (base di campo)

Come collegamento medico-scientifico (MSL) per la Svizzera franco-italiana, farai parte del team Affari medici e sarai responsabile dello scambio scientifico con i leader delle opinioni chiave e gli operatori sanitari. Sarai un punto di contatto competente per le indagini mediche e scientifiche e contribuirà a tradurre le attuali prove scientifiche in pratica clinica.

In questo ruolo, lavorerete in stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate interne ed esterne e sosterrete la strategia medica attraverso la creazione di partenariati scientifici sostenibili e la comunicazione di informazioni basate su prove.

Le vostre responsabilità

• Responsabile dello scambio medico-scientifico dei prodotti nei settori della Dermatologia terapeutica e dell' Estetica Iniettabile

• Costruire e mantenere rapporti scientifici a lungo termine con operatori sanitari e leader di opinione chiave nella parte francese/italiano parlando della Svizzera

• Presentare e comunicare contenuti scientifici e medici durante incontri, incontri ed eventi scientifici individuali

• Sviluppare ed eseguire attività mediche e scientifiche in linea con la strategia per gli Affari medici

• Fornire informazioni mediche scientificamente valide agli stakeholder interni ed esterni

• Collaborazione con i team di Medicina, Vendite, Marketing e altri team interfunzionali

• Monitoraggio degli sviluppi scientifici pertinenti e del mercato sanitario locale e approfondimenti medici

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea in Medicina, Farmacia, Scienze della Salute, o un campo comparabile (MSc o PhD)

• Esperienza professionale in ambito medico nell'industria farmaceutica

• Esperienza con terapie biologiche o sistemiche, idealmente in Dermatologia, Immunologia, Allergologia o aree terapeutiche correlate

• Esperienza nello sviluppo e nella presentazione di contenuti scientifici al pubblico medico

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e gestione delle relazioni, nonché esperienza nella costruzione di reti professionali

• Abilità fluenti in lingua francese e inglese, sia scritte che parlate

• La volontà di viaggiare in Svizzera (circa l'80%)

Cosa offriamo

Lavorerete per un'azienda impegnata nella diversità e nell'inclusione e credete che i risultati migliori si raggiungano quando riprendiamo le prospettive della nostra base di clienti diversificata.

Galderma SA offre una cultura aperta basata sul rispetto reciproco.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Galderma ist der aufstrebende Marktführer in der Kategorie der Reinspiel-Dermatologie, der in rund 90 Ländern vertreten ist. Wir bieten ein innovatives, wissenschaftsbasiertes Portfolio an Premium-Flaggschiffmarken und -Services, die das gesamte Spektrum des schnell wachsenden Dermatologiemarktes durch injizierbare Ästhetik, Dermatologische Hautpflege und diabetische Dermatologie abdecken. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 1901 widmen wir uns dem größten Organ des menschlichen Körpers – der Haut – mit überlegenen Ergebnissen in Partnerschaft mit medizinischen Fachkräften den individuellen Bedürfnissen von Konsumenten und Patienten.

Weil wir verstehen, dass die Haut, wir sind in Formen unser Leben, wir sind die Dermatologie für jede Hautgeschichte voran.

Wir suchen Menschen, die sich auf das Erzielen von Ergebnissen konzentrieren, lernen und positive Energie bringen. Sie müssen Initiative mit einem Gefühl von Teamarbeit und Zusammenarbeit verbinden. Sie müssen vor allem leidenschaftlich etwas Sinnvolles für Verbraucher, Patienten und die Gesundheitsberufe tun, die wir täglich bedienen. Wir wollen jeden Mitarbeiter stärken und sein persönliches Wachstum fördern, während wir sicherstellen, dass die geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse jetzt und in die Zukunft erfüllt werden.

Bei Galderma geben wir unseren Teams aktiv Grund, an unseren kühnen Ehrgeiz zu glauben, das führende Dermatologie-Unternehmen der Welt zu werden. Mit uns haben Sie die ultimative Chance, neue und herausfordernde Arbeitserfahrungen zu sammeln und eine unvergleichliche, direkte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Medizinische wissenschaftliche Verbindung, Romandie & Tessin

Ort: Romandie & Tessin Schweiz (Feldbasiert)

Als Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) für den französisch-italienischen Teil der Schweiz sind Sie Teil des Teams Medical Affairs und sind für den wissenschaftlichen Austausch mit Key Opinion Leaders und Healthcare Professionals verantwortlich. Sie dienen als kompetenter Ansprechpartner für medizinische und wissenschaftliche Untersuchungen und tragen dazu bei, aktuelle wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse in die klinische Praxis umzusetzen.

In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen und unterstützen die medizinische Strategie, indem Sie nachhaltige wissenschaftliche Partnerschaften aufbauen und evidenzbasierte Informationen vermitteln.

Ihre Verantwortung

• Verantwortlich für den medizinischen und wissenschaftlichen Austausch zu Produkten in den Bereichen der Dermatologie und Injektivität

• Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger wissenschaftlicher Beziehungen zu Angehörigen der Gesundheitsberufe und führenden Meinungsbildner in der französisch-italienischen Region der Schweiz

• Präsentation und Kommunikation wissenschaftlicher und medizinischer Inhalte während Einzeltreffen, Tagungen und wissenschaftlichen Veranstaltungen

• Entwicklung und Durchführung medizinischer und wissenschaftlicher Aktivitäten im Einklang mit der Strategie für medizinische Angelegenheiten

• Bereitstellung wissenschaftlich fundierter medizinischer Informationen für interne und externe Stakeholder

• Zusammenarbeit mit medizinischen Angelegenheiten, Vertrieb, Marketing und anderen funktionsübergreifenden Teams

• Überwachung relevanter wissenschaftlicher Entwicklungen und des lokalen Gesundheitsmarktes und Ableitung medizinischer Erkenntnisse

Ihr Profil

• Studium in Medizin, Pharmazie, Gesundheitswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet (MSc oder PhD)

• Berufserfahrung in der Medizin in der Pharmaindustrie

• Erfahrungen mit biologischen oder systemischen Therapien, idealerweise in Dermatologie, Immunologie, Allergie oder verwandten therapeutischen Bereichen

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Präsentation wissenschaftlicher Inhalte für medizinisches Publikum

• Starke Kommunikation, Präsentation und Beziehungsmanagement Fähigkeiten, sowie Erfahrung im Aufbau professioneller Netzwerke

• Fließende Sprachkenntnisse in Französisch und Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen

• Bereitschaft, in der Schweiz weithin zu reisen (ca. 80%)

Was wir anbieten

Sie arbeiten für ein Unternehmen, das sich der Vielfalt und Inklusion verpflichtet und glaubt, dass bessere Ergebnisse erzielt werden, wenn wir die Perspektiven unserer vielfältigen Kundenbasis widerspiegeln.

Galderma SA bietet eine offene Kultur, die auf gegenseitigem Respekt basiert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Galderma est le leader émergent de la catégorie de la dératologie pure-jouée, présent dans environ 90 pays. Nous offrons un portefeuille de marques et de services phares innovants et scientifiques qui couvrent tout le spectre du marché de la dératologie en pleine croissance grâce à l'esthétique injectable, aux soins de la peau dermatologique et à la dermatologie thérapeutique. Depuis notre fondation en 1981, nous avons consacré notre attention et notre passion au plus grand organe du corps humain - la peau - répondant aux besoins individuels des consommateurs et des patients avec des résultats supérieurs en partenariat avec les professionnels de la santé.

Parce que nous comprenons que la peau, nous sommes dans les formes de nos vies, nous faisons avancer la dératologie pour chaque histoire de peau.

Nous cherchons des gens qui se concentrent sur les résultats, qui apprennent et qui apportent une énergie positive. Ils doivent combiner l'initiative avec un sens du travail d'équipe et de la collaboration. Surtout, ils doivent être passionnés de faire quelque chose de significatif pour les consommateurs, les patients et les professionnels de la santé que nous servons chaque jour. Nous visons à autonomiser chaque employé et à promouvoir sa croissance personnelle tout en veillant à ce que les besoins des entreprises soient satisfaits maintenant et dans l'avenir.

Chez Galderma, nous donnons à nos équipes des raisons de croire en notre ambition audacieuse de devenir la première entreprise de dermatologie au monde. Avec nous, vous avez l'ultime opportunité d'acquérir de nouvelles expériences de travail stimulantes et de créer un impact direct sans précédent.

Liaison scientifique médicale, Romandie & Ticino

Lieu: Romandie & Ticino Suisse (Field Based)

En tant que responsable de la liaison scientifique médicale (MSL) pour la Suisse francophone/italienne, vous ferez partie de l'équipe des affaires médicales et serez responsable des échanges scientifiques avec les leaders de l'opinion clé et les professionnels de la santé. Vous serez un point de contact compétent pour les enquêtes médicales et scientifiques et contribuerez à la traduction des données scientifiques actuelles en pratique clinique.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants internes et externes et appuyerez la stratégie médicale en établissant des partenariats scientifiques durables et en communiquant de l'information fondée sur des données probantes.

Vos responsabilités

• Responsable des échanges médicaux et scientifiques concernant les produits dans les domaines de la dermatologie thérapeutique et de l'esthétisme injectable

• Établir et maintenir des relations scientifiques à long terme avec les professionnels de la santé et les leaders clés de l'opinion dans la partie francophone/italienne de la Suisse

• Présenter et communiquer des contenus scientifiques et médicaux lors de réunions individuelles, de réunions et de manifestations scientifiques

• Développer et exécuter des activités médicales et scientifiques conformément à la stratégie relative aux affaires médicales

• Fournir des informations médicales scientifiquement valables aux parties prenantes internes et externes

• Collaborer avec des équipes médicales, commerciales, marketing et autres équipes interfonctionnelles

• Suivre les évolutions scientifiques pertinentes et le marché local des soins de santé et dégager des perspectives médicales

Votre profil

• Diplôme en médecine, pharmacie, sciences de la santé ou domaine comparable (MSc ou doctorat)

• Expérience professionnelle en affaires médicales dans l'industrie pharmaceutique

• Expérience avec des produits biologiques ou des thérapies systémiques, idéalement en dermatologie, immunologie, allergologie ou domaines thérapeutiques connexes

• Expérience dans le développement et la présentation de contenus scientifiques au public médical

• Des compétences solides en communication, présentation et gestion des relations, ainsi que de l'expérience dans la création de réseaux professionnels

• Compétences linguistiques en français et en anglais, écrites et parlées

• Volonté de voyager en Suisse (environ 80%)

Ce que nous offrons

Vous travaillerez pour une entreprise qui s'engage à la diversité et à l'inclusion et qui croit que de meilleurs résultats sont obtenus lorsque nous reflétons les perspectives de notre clientèle diversifiée.

Galderma SA offre une culture ouverte basée sur le respect mutuel.

Job title:  Regional Head of Human Resources EMEAC
Location:  Zug (Switzerland), London (UK), or Frankfurt (Germany) - 3-4 days/week onsite
Reports to:  CHRO

Role purpose
The Regional Head of HR EMEAC provides strategic HR leadership for Galderma across Europe, Middle East, Africa and Canada. This role partners closely with regional business leadership to shape and execute the people strategy, enable business growth, drive organizational effectiveness, and ensure consistent application of Galderma’s global HR policies and values across diverse markets.

Key responsibilities

Strategic HR leadership

• Develop and implement the EMEAC people strategy aligned with Galderma’s global HR and business priorities.

• Act as primary HR business partner to the EMEAC regional leadership team, providing insight, challenge, and guidance on organizational and talent decisions.

• Translate business objectives into clear HR plans and priorities for the region, including workforce planning, capability building, and organization design.

Organization & talent

• Lead regional talent management processes, including succession planning for critical roles and high‑potential development.

• Drive strategic workforce planning, including build‑buy‑borrow‑bot decisions and resource allocation across markets and functions.

• Support organizational design and change initiatives to ensure structures, roles, and ways of working enable performance and collaboration.

Culture, engagement & leadership

• Champion Galderma’s culture and values across EMEAC, ensuring they are embedded in leadership, people processes, and daily behaviours.

• Use engagement and pulse survey data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and collaborate with leaders on action plans.

• Coach senior leaders on inclusive leadership, performance management, and effective people management.

HR operations & governance

• Ensure consistent and compliant implementation of HR policies, processes, and employment practices across EMEAC, working closely with local HR and Legal where needed.

• Oversee regional alignment on compensation & benefits frameworks, performance management, and recognition, in partnership with global COEs.

• Monitor HR KPIs (e.g. attrition, internal mobility, time‑to‑hire, diversity metrics) and drive continuous improvement across the region.

Business partnering & collaboration

• Build strong partnerships with Country HR Heads and HR COEs (Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Reward, etc.) to deliver integrated HR solutions.

• Act as a key liaison between global HR and EMEAC countries to ensure two‑way communication of priorities, feedback, and local needs.

• Contribute to global HR projects and initiatives, bringing an EMEAC perspective and ensuring regional deployment.

Change & transformation

• Lead or support regional change programs (e.g. reorganizations, integrations, new operating models), ensuring robust change and communication plans.

• Drive adoption of HR systems and digital tools in the region, supporting data quality, self‑service, and user experience.

Risk, compliance & ethics

• Ensure HR practices in the region adhere to Galderma policies, local labor law, data privacy requirements, and ethical standards.

• Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Privacy on employment‑related risk management, investigations, and remediation, as appropriate.

Qualifications & experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or related field; Master’s degree or equivalent HR qualification is an advantage.

• Significant HR leadership experience including leading HR in complex, multi‑country, matrix environments.

• Proven track record as a strategic HR Business Partner to senior leaders, ideally in healthcare, pharma, consumer health, or related industries.

• Demonstrated experience in organization design, change management, and talent management at regional or global level.

• Strong understanding of employment practices across key EMEAC markets; experience working across multiple cultures and legal frameworks.

• Fluent in English; additional European languages are an asset.

Skills & competencies

• Strategic thinking and strong business acumen, able to connect people strategy with commercial outcomes.

• Influencing and stakeholder management skills, with credibility at senior leadership level.

• Strong coaching and advisory capabilities, with the ability to challenge constructively.

• Data‑driven decision making, comfortable using HR analytics to identify issues and shape actions.

• Resilient, pragmatic, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, evolving environment.

• Inclusive leadership mindset, committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Working conditions

• Role based in Zug, Frankfurt or London, with regular travel across the EMEAC region as required.

• Operates in a hybrid, international, matrix environment, collaborating closely with business leaders and HR colleagues globally.

Titolo del lavoro: Regional Head of Human Resources EMEAC
Posizione: Zug (Svizzera), Londra (UK), o Francoforte (Germania) - 3-4 giorni/settimana in loco

Scopo di rotazione
Il Capo Regionale delle Risorse Umane EMEAC fornisce la leadership strategica delle risorse umane per Galderma in tutta Europa, Medio Oriente, Africa e Canada. Leader strategico delle risorse umane

• Sviluppare e implementare la strategia del popolo EMEAC allineato con le priorità globali di Galderma HR e business.

• Agire come partner principale di business HR per il team di leadership regionale EMEAC, fornendo comprensione, sfida e guida sulle decisioni organizzative e di talento.

• Sostenere le iniziative di progettazione e cambiamento organizzativi per garantire strutture, ruoli e modi di lavoro consentono prestazioni e collaborazione.

Cultura, impegno e leadership
